# compute_p_array_bp {#sec-doc}


::: {.callout-note appearance="simple" title="docblock" collapse=false}


```julia
compute_p_array_bp(data, w; chart_choice, refinement, add_noise=false)
```
Compute the relative SOP type frequencies of every image in an image sequence for all delay combinations `(d1, d2) ∈ {1,…,w} × {1,…,w}`. These frequencies are the input of the bootstrap functions for the BP statistics, [`arl_sop_bp_bootstrap`](arl_sop_bp_bootstrap.qmd) and [`cl_sop_bp_bootstrap`](cl_sop_bp_bootstrap.qmd).
 
Returns a 3-dimensional array of size `(number of images, number of SOP types, w²)`.
 
  * `data::Array{T,3}`: image sequence (third dimension = time).
  * `w::Int`: maximal delay in both directions.
  * `chart_choice`: chart the frequencies are computed for; see [`stat_sop_bp`](stat_sop_bp.qmd).
  * `refinement`: [`OrdinaryType`](OrdinaryType.qmd)`()` or one of [`RotationType`](RotationType.qmd)`()`, [`DirectionType`](DirectionType.qmd)`()`, [`DiagonalType`](DiagonalType.qmd)`()`.
  * `add_noise=false`: add uniform noise to the data to break ties.


:::
